Liebman, New York, NY, 1920s; Descended in family; Parke-Bernet Galleries, Inc., New York, NY, sale no. 1976, lot no. 98, 18 May 1960; Private collection, Los Angeles, California, 1960; Descended in family; (Robert Miller Gallery, Inc., New York, NY), 1994; Private collection, Los Angeles, California, 1996; (Lisa Kurts Fine Art, Memphis, Tennesse) (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Mrs. Liebman's apartment, Jan. 1946. . . . No signature. Three calla lilies. Title given by Rosalind Irvine. Owned by Mrs. Charles J. Liebman. . . . O'Keeffe thinks ab. 1923, but might be later." (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Calla Lilies

description: Three white calla lilies stretch from the bottom to the top of the composition. The lilies have undulating green stems and delicate white leaves, each with a yellow spike protruding from its center. The lilies shine against a rippling burgundy background with gray curtain-like forms that frame the flowers.
title: Calla Lilies
